what_this_is: Every alias in the deity and concept registries, checked against 206,440 human-annotated words. For each: how often that exact surface form occurs as a whole word in the human corpus, and which lemma the annotators gave it.
why_per_alias: A layer-level precision of 98% can contain an alias that is wrong every time. Two random per-row samples in this project once reported 97%+ while one alias was 82.9% wrong.
